rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: On the afternoon of 22 October the standing committee decided the motion for the 14 November extraordinary convention: members would mutually accept both choices, keeping the SDP or answering the call and joining the Constitutional Democratic Party.
